extra.reason: Exact Zig-main tooling pin, bootstrap verification, and bump policy implemented; owner mirroring moved to release gate cgz-7v2.3.
Exact upstream archive/tree/package/license provenance and commit range implemented and independently verified; owner mirroring moved to release gate.
Fresh-cache Debug/ReleaseSafe/package/module and cross-build validation proves the source-less module failure is fixed without weakening the approved graph.
Binding no-relaxation policy and machine-enforced gate-strength checks implemented and integrated into CI policy validation.
ZON dependency/package policy, lazy exact oracle, std-only production isolation, offline package flow, and consumer/install checks implemented and freshly validated.
Reserved public build steps now fail explicitly with owning Bead IDs and the gate-strength policy prevents dependency-free false-green steps.

Oracle static library, upstream example link-and-run proof, minimal MAE reader, and fixture loading for all six fixtures plus templates.mae are implemented and verified on a fresh cache; oracle remains lazy and never installed.
Oracle hook captures exact template mapping and component placement evidence
Stable ABI and conformance-only probe surfaces are built, exercised, and isolated

Seeded corpus with pinned PRNG, architecture and allocator-order axes, per-member-per-observable classification with size bucket and ok flag, portable expectations gate, and published parity manifest are implemented, measured, and wired into CI.
All four build defects fixed and verified: upstream-oracle is green including the r04 ABI smoke tests, which had never executed.
Adapter re-establishes _generalUseN before morganScores, as upstream's own canonicalOrdering does; the full 2000-member adversarial corpus now runs the probe path without corruption.
Fixed and verified: run 30755015861 green on both legs with the aarch64 corpus actually executing; merged to main in PR #2 (725f476).

Acceptance met and now reproduced on clean hosts. build.zig carries -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic on every C check and -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror on the C++ check, with zero -Wno- suppressions (grep -n '\-Wno-' build.zig is empty). Both defect lines are fixed at source: tests/abi_layout.c:28 casts before the static assert, include/coordgen_abi.h:205 uses memset plus explicit field init. abi-check and abi-check -Doptimize=safe pass on ubuntu-24.04 and macos-14 from a fetched-then-offline cache in CI run 30755015861; tools/check-build-policy enforces the flags and the no-suppression rule so a future relaxation fails the build rather than needing to be noticed.

All four deliverables done. Phase 0 tree committed; origin configured (git@github.com:zachcp/coordgen-zig.git) and pushed; CI has now executed on ubuntu-24.04 and macos-14 and passes green (run 30755015861), which is what converts the recorded local validation into a reproduced result; concurrent-agent working agreement recorded in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md; .tools/ ignored and absent from history. CI immediately earned its keep: its first runs found cgz-r23, a three-layer defect in the corpus architecture axis that no local macOS run could have surfaced.

Remaining acceptance blocker (cgz-r04 wiring the record into the live oracle probe surface and enforcing non-installation) is met, and cgz-r04/r04.1 are closed. Evidence: conformance/oracle_adapter.cpp:533 exports coordgen_probe_generate and fills coordgen_probe_dof_t from live upstream objects, classifying all seven CoordgenFragmentDOF subclasses; tests/oracle_corpus_run.zig calls that live entry point and emits per-DOF state, penalty, and membership; the classification consumes them as first-class observables (dofs, dofs_set, dof_penalties, dof_penalties_set appear in conformance/parity_expectations.tsv and across 44 rows of conformance/parity_manifest.tsv). src/conformance/probe_types.zig holds the Zig mirror with layout tests against coordgen_probe.h, checked by tests/probe_layout.c in abi-check. Non-installation is enforced by tools/check-install-isolation, which fails if coordgen_probe.h or any oracle-named artifact reaches the prefix. All of it now runs on ubuntu-24.04 and macos-14 in CI run 30755015861. Fragment and optimizer beads may now be created.

Final acceptance item met. tests/rdkit_consumer.cpp links the RDKit-shaped flow against the pinned C++ facade through the stable C ABI and runs under zig build upstream-oracle. Input order is deliberately not connectivity order, so the input-index contract is falsifiable: bonded pairs measure 49.996-50.001 apart when addressed by input index, and renumbering every atom through an unrelated permutation reproduces the whole distance matrix with deviation exactly 0. Tolerances derive from those measurements (0.05 on a value of 50); the check was falsified first (asserting 40 fails with the measured lengths reported). Verified green on ubuntu-24.04 and macos-14 in CI run 30755920857; merged to main in PR #3 (8ee3070). The remaining items were already met per the prior notes: option table, DTO coverage, adversarial-order test in src/model.zig, exported bond-length-50 constant, and single-shot ABI making illegal call orders unrepresentable.
